subject: Q3 renewal check-in — capacity, spend, and upsell options
messages:
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 renewal check-in — usage spike and term planning

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re doing well. As we approach our contract renewal window (Nov 1), we want to surface a few items from our side before the formal review:

- Usage: We saw a 2.6x jump in token spend in July after the new recommendation model rolled out.
- Performance: Latency regressions in region us-west during peak hours (logs attached) impacted a small % of transactions.
- Budget: We’re tracking to exceed committed spend if usage remains at current levels.

Can your team share a short health recap (token breakdown by endpoint, latency percentiles, and any root-cause for the regressions)? Procurement also asked for optional terms if we need to increase committed capacity mid-term.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call next week.

—Sarah
Sarah Green
Head of Platform, Acme, Inc.
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal check-in — usage spike and term planning

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the log snippets. I put together a concise health pack attached (acme_q2_inference_performance_report.pdf) plus a raw usage CSV. High-level notes:

- Token mix: 65% generation; 25% embeddings; 10% reranking. The July spike is concentrated in generation calls to /v1/chat (peak hour 14:00–15:00 PDT).
- Latency: P95 increased from 210ms -> 430ms during the spike window; root cause appears to be elevated concurrent short-sequence traffic causing smaller batch sizes and less efficient kernel selection. Monica and our runtime team have a mitigation plan (auto-burst routing + dynamic batching policy) that reduces P95 back to ~230ms in staging.
- Economics: At current run-rate you’ll exceed committed credits by ~18% over the next quarter. We’ve modeled a couple of options in the attached ROI sheet: simple top-up vs a stepped commit with a small term extension.

Attachments: acme_q2_inference_performance_report.pdf, acme_usage_breakdown_q3.csv

Proposed next steps:
1) Short call with engineering to confirm mitigation (30 min) — Monica + runtime.
2) Commercial options: a mid-term commit increase vs flexible burst credits. Karthik can share pricing for both.

Are you available Fri 8/13 10:00am PT for the tech sync?

Best,
Hannah
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal check-in — usage spike and term planning

Sarah — appreciate the detail, and thanks Hannah for the pack. Two commercial vehicles we recommend depending on how Acme wants to balance flexibility vs unit economics:

Option A — Flex Burst + Top-up (minimal term change)
- One-time burst credit bundle (20% of current monthly run-rate) for immediate headroom.
- No long-term commitment change.
- Effective blended token rate: current list (no discount).

Option B — Stepped Commit with Short Extension (better unit economics)
- Increase committed tokens by 30% and add a 9‑month extension to synchronize with Acme’s product roadmap.
- 12% discount on overage compared to current overage pricing.
- Includes one free capacity tuning workshop and priority routing for peak windows.

I’ve attached a draft term amendment you can share with procurement (term_amendment_draft.docx). If you prefer, we can put numbers into a formal SOW. Sean — FYI, this could be an upsell motion with minor margin impact if we include the workshop.

Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal check-in — usage spike and term planning

Thanks — all helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement and engineering:

- Procurement: Can you provide a clear before/after ROI showing monthly cost at current run-rate vs Option B stepped commit? They need a 6‑month forecast.
- Engineering: The staging mitigation looks promising; before we accept any term change we need assurances around peak SLOs and an agreed rollback if regressions return.

Also: if we do Option B, can you make the extension end date align with our fiscal year (ending Aug 31, 2028)? Procurement prefers calendar alignment and wants the draft term with redlines.

We’ll be available for a 30-min call Tue 8/17 11:00am PT.

—Sarah
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal check-in — usage spike and term planning

Great — thanks Sarah. Quick rundown ahead of tomorrow’s call and what I’ll bring:

1) ROI packet (attached) — month-by-month cost comparison (current run-rate, Option A, Option B) + simple NPV over 6 months.
2) SLO guardrails for Option B — we’ll commit to a routing playbook and a two-week rollback clause if peak P95 exceeds agreed thresholds more than 3x in a rolling week. Monica will own the runbook.
3) Commercial: proposed 9‑month extension now aligned to 8/31/2028 (per procurement) + 12% discount on overages for the stepped commit. Karthik will prepare a redline-ready amendment and an alternative with 20% burst credits if you prefer flexibility.

Action items before call:
- Sarah/procurement: confirm whether you want the extension to end 8/31/2028 (yes/no).
- Monica: will run a quick synthetic peak test in staging and share results on the call.
- Karthik: upload redline-ready terms and a pricing table to the HubSpot deal.

Meeting invite sent for Tue 8/17 11:00am PT. Looking forward to closing the loop.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
